# Van Zyl eye cohort, full cohort: recipe by count dependence

<!-- glance:begin (generated by analysis/make_index.py; do not edit by hand) -->
Chooses the recipe of the five-species eye cohort by count dependence, a rule that reads alpha, the prior and the count evidence only.

| | |
|---|---|
| Question | Model fits beyond the canonical runs: Which further seeds, platform repeats and cohort recipes were trained, and how was each recipe chosen? |
| Status | recipe search |
| Environment | `chimera_env` |
| Used in the paper | Supplementary Table S19 (`tab:harmonised-cohorts`); Supplementary Section C.21.1 (`sssec:rev-plan`) |
| How we know | described in the Extended Methods |

**Run**, from the repository root, in the order given (set `PYTHONPATH=$PWD` for commands that name a file; `-m` commands need nothing):

    python -m analysis.tasks.T11_2c_count_rule.select_count
    sbatch --array=0-<rows-1> analysis/slurm/array.sbatch analysis/tasks/T11_2c_count_rule/manifest.tsv

**Writes** (with the deposit bundle that holds it, see `REPRODUCE.md`)

- `results/analysis/T11/count_rule/`: bundle `analysis_results`
- `training/runs/rev-vz-grid2-s<seed>/`: bundle `models_seeds_controls_cohorts`

**Reads** (as named in the code)

- `training/runs/`

**Notes.** README.md states the rule. Writes under results/analysis/T11/, not T11_2c.
<!-- glance:end -->

The full-cohort recipe was first chosen by the integration composite. Under the amended rule (amendment log of the pre-specified analysis plan), recipes rank on count dependence. Grids 2 and 6 were not selectable before (saturation 7.7%, 6.7%, now allowed up to 10%).

**Runs.** `rev-vz-grid2-s43`, `-s44`, `rev-vz-grid6-s43`, `-s44` (`manifest.tsv`; the grid rows of `T11_2_recipe/grid.tsv`, seed replaced, on build 3 of `T11_1_vanzyl`). With the s42 grid runs, and grid 1's seeds (`rev-vz-grid1-s42`, `rev-vz-s43` to `s46`).

**Rule (`select_count.py`).** Among grids 1, 2, 6 with at least 2 healthy seeds (no NaN, 10/10 active z dims, saturation at most 10%, both tails against the raw prior), per grid the mean over healthy seeds of rho = Spearman(alpha - prior as anchored, S_g_ema) on genes with count support (|S_g_ema| >= 1e-6). Highest mean wins; a difference under 0.02 goes to the lower grid id. No gold, gene set or glaucoma result enters.

**Stated.** V1-V3 on grid 1 had already been computed and read by the analyst before this rule was applied. The selection is mechanical and reads rho only. Grid 1's readouts are reported beside the winner's.
